g.text: Accept PDF, DOCX, TXT or MD only
Presigned upload URL and storage key
PUT the file to the private documents bucket
Check the object exists and is under 10 MB
One database transaction, under a per-writer lock
Extract the text page by page
[over 200 pages, or no text layer to read]
Set the status to failed, with a readable reason
Split into chunks, keeping each chunk's page
In one transaction, replace the chunks
and set the status to ready, with the page count
GET /documents (the list polls while a row is in progress)
Ready, or failed with its reason
Set the status back to pending
The file never passes through the api: the browser puts it straight
into the private bucket. The bucket has no anonymous read policy, so
the file is served back only through GET /documents/:id/file, as a
